title: Sampotes
extract:
Sampotes is a Duviri Hammer wielded by Dax Malleus. Its Slam and Heavy Slam attacks generate multiple shockwaves, ragdolling enemies and sending them flying.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Crushing Ruin stance.
Unique Slam Attack unleashes a line of 8 explosions every 5 meters, each dealing ? damage in a 5 meter radius.
Specific Stance Combos that contain slams can trigger the line of explosions too.  Crushing Ruin and its block+neutral can make it easy to spam this unique effect.
Unique Heavy Slam Attack unleashes 3 lines of 4 explosions in a fan, each dealing ? damage in a 7 meter radius.

Drifter Combat
Power Strike (blocking + heavy attack, default RMB  + MMB ) slams the ground to release a shockwave that travels forward in a line, inflicting  Heat damage with guaranteed procs.
Ground slam can hit the same target multiple times.

Acquisition
The Blueprint for Sampotes can be purchased in Teshin's Cave for 60  Pathos Clamp or  275. Purchasing using the former will unlock the Drifter-compatible version and the blueprint for a Warframe-compatible version; purchasing using the latter will unlock both versions.
Additional Warframe blueprint copies can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000.

Combos

Notes
Sampotes can apply multiple instances of Lifted, resulting in enemies being Ragdolled.

Shockwaves
The shockwaves created by its Slam and Heavy Slam attacks have extreme Lifting-Ragdolling properties, making the Sampotes an effective crowd control melee.
Heavy Slam shockwave damage is unaffected by the Melee Combo multiplier. Shockwaves can still benefit from mods that scale with melee combo counter, such as  Blood Rush and  Weeping Wounds.
Slam and Heavy Slam shockwave damage is unaffected by  Condition Overload.
Both light and heavy slam shockwaves have a base 10.00% Status Chance.
